text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening stance: 'I have a positive viewpoint on driverless cars'","quality":"explicit thesis","description":"The essay states a direct position early so the reader immediately knows the argument being made."},{"evidence":"repeated 'I wouldn't buy one anytime soon' and 'we still should pay attention'","quality":"qualified argumentation","description":"The essay acknowledges benefits while also limiting its support with reservations, making the position more nuanced."},{"evidence":"'it needs to be tested more' and 'they are safer'","quality":"reasoned support","description":"The essay gives at least a basic rationale for its caution by pointing to safety and testing concerns."},{"evidence":"paragraph on 'make moral choices' and the life-threatening decision example","quality":"counterargument development","description":"The essay develops a concrete objection about ethical decision-making rather than only listing opinions."},{"evidence":"'What if... what could this bring us? ... what are the other possibilities'","quality":"conclusion with broader reflection","description":"The ending goes beyond restating the claim by reflecting on future possibilities and the larger significance of the topic."}]}
